statement: SELECT concat_ws(' | ', cast(date(window.start) as string), drift_type, cast(round(ks_statistic,3) as string), cast(round(js_distance,4) as string), cast(round(wasserstein_distance,3) as string)) AS row FROM workspace.mlpab768409.prediction_log_drift_metrics WHERE column_name='prediction' AND date(window.start) BETWEEN '2026-03-05' AND '2026-03-11' ORDER BY window.start, drift_type
